editor.title: Clip editor
editor.subtitle: Cut and join your recordings and videos, add text, music and transitions, and export as a vertical short or a landscape video in one click.
editor.feature1Desc: Even hour-long recordings open right away; jump to any moment on the timeline.
editor.feature2Desc: Split with S, drag, put clips on an upper layer and add transitions between them.
editor.feature3Desc: Presets for shorts, landscape video, feed posts and 10/16 MB sharing limits; no watermark.
editor.playlistNotSupported: This is a playlist. Open the link of a single video in the editor.
editor.noDuration: The length of this source is unknown (it may be a live stream), so it cannot be edited.
editor.notDownloaded: not downloaded, playing from the internet
editor.localUnplayable: This file's format cannot be played in the preview. A lightweight preview copy can be created; exports still use the original file.
editor.copyFailed: The preview copy could not be created.
editor.remoteFailed: The preview could not be opened (the link may have expired or access may be restricted). You can still pick scenes on the timeline.
editor.noPreview: This source cannot be played inside the app. You can still pick scenes on the timeline and export them.
editor.frameEmpty: The playhead is not on a clip.
editor.addSourceHint: Add another video file or link; its clips are merged on the same timeline.
editor.removeSourceConfirm: This source has {{count}} clips; remove them together with the source?
editor.multiSourceHint: When different sources are merged, video is scaled to a common size and frame rate and re-encoded; this can take a bit longer.
editor.mediaHint: Add videos or audio to the project; you can drag a card onto the timeline.
editor.mediaDropHint: Drag and drop files here; dragging a card onto the timeline adds the whole source.
editor.mediaCardHint: Click: preview · Drag: add to timeline
editor.appendToTimeline: Append the whole source to the timeline
editor.preciseMultiHint: Precise cutting is off when multiple sources are used; cuts snap to the nearest keyframe (fast mode).
editor.mergeOn_other: {{count}} parts become one file, in order
editor.nothingToExport: No clips left on the timeline. Undo (Ctrl+Z) or use "Put the video back on the timeline" on the Clip tab.
editor.onlySelectedDownloaded: Only the selected parts are downloaded, not the whole {{full}} video.
editor.newLayerHint: Drag a clip here: an upper layer plays instead of the one below
editor.magnet: Magnet: edges snap to the playhead and other clips (hold Alt to bypass)
editor.speedHint: Speeding up makes the clip shorter, slowing down makes it longer. Audio follows.
editor.gapsSkipped: Gaps between clips become black screen. Don't want that? Use "Close gaps" on the Clip tab.
editor.addWholeSource: Put the video back on the timeline
editor.howtoSplit: Move the playhead (white line) to the start of the scene and press {{key}}; move it to the end and press {{key}} again. The part in between becomes its own clip.
editor.howtoDelete: Click a clip you don't want and press {{key}}. The gap left behind turns into black screen on export; "Close gaps" pulls the clips together.
editor.howtoTrim: Drag a clip's left or right edge: shorten it, or lengthen it again if the source has more.
editor.howtoLayers: Drag a clip by its middle to move it; drop it on the empty row above and it goes to an upper layer, playing instead of what's below.
editor.howtoMenu: Right-click: play, split, duplicate, keep only this, speed.
editor.resumeSkipped: Some sources could not be opened and were skipped: {{titles}}
editor.gapPreview: Gap: no clip here. This part becomes black screen on export.
editor.gifHint: GIFs have no sound. Keep it short: under 10 seconds works best for chat apps.
editor.gifLong: This GIF is {{seconds}} seconds long and may be a very large file. Try shortening it or lowering the width.
editor.splitChaptersHint: Every chapter becomes its own clip named after it; select the ones you don't want and delete them.
editor.chapterRemoved: This chapter was removed from the timeline
editor.fadeHint: The picture fades from or to black and the sound fades with it.
editor.frameCropHint: You can also drag the yellow frame in the preview; everything outside it is cut.
editor.frameFitHint: The whole picture stays; empty edges become black.
editor.textHint: Drag the text in the preview to place it. Set when it shows with the purple block on the timeline: drag its edges to lengthen or shorten it.
editor.trackHide: Hide this layer (the one below shows)
editor.exportDialogHint: Pick the format and quality; your clips are merged into one file. For a vertical frame, close this and drag the kept area in the preview.
editor.lookPickClip: No clip under the playhead. Move the playhead onto a clip or select one on the timeline; select several clips to change them all at once.
editor.filtersHint: One-click color mood: black & white, sepia, cinema… You see it in the preview right away.
editor.colorHint: Fine-tune light and color. The middle value is the video as it is.
editor.effectsHint: Blur, mirror or darken the edges.
editor.templatesHint: Click a template to add text where the playhead is. Then change its words, position and length.
editor.transitionsHint: The clip fading in from black/white at its start or fading out at its end. Drag a card onto a clip edge, or click it to apply to the selected clip.
editor.transitionsPick: Select a clip on the timeline first (otherwise it goes on the clip under the playhead).
editor.transitionsDragHint: Drag onto a cut or a clip; click to add it to the selected clip
editor.subtitlesHint: Have a .srt file? Import it: every line becomes text on the timeline and is burned into the video on export.
editor.subtitlesBox: Put a translucent box behind the text
editor.subtitlesEmpty: No readable subtitle lines were found in this file.
editor.presetsHint: Save a look or text style you like under a name and reuse it in one click. Export it as a file to share with friends.
editor.presetFromText: The selected text's style will be saved.
editor.presetFromLook: The selected clip's look (filter, color, effects) will be saved.
editor.presetNothing: Select a clip with a changed look, or a text, to save it.
editor.presetsNone: No presets were found in the file.

motionHint.zoomIn: Slowly zooms in over the clip
motionHint.panLeft: The picture slides right to left
motionHint.panRight: The picture slides left to right
motionHint.kenBurns: Zooms in while drifting diagonally (documentary feel)
motionHint.shake: Camera shake for explosions, goals and hits
motionHint.pulse: Zoom that beats like a pulse, great with music

editor.transitionStyleHint: How the selected clip enters and leaves. Change the length with the transitions above or the clip transition setting.
editor.frameBlurHint: The picture stays whole in the middle; the empty bands fill with a blurred copy of the same video (the usual look of short videos).

presetHint.discord: Fits a 10 MB file limit (e.g. chat apps)

editor.targetSize: The file is shrunk to fit ~{{size}} MB (quality drops on long videos).
editor.fastExportHint: Uses the graphics card encoder, usually 3x faster, and keeps the CPU free.
editor.fastExportNoGpu: No suitable graphics card encoder was found on this computer.
editor.musicHint: Add music or a sound effect: it starts at the playhead and ends with the video, mixed with the clip sound.
editor.musicNoAudio: No audio was found in this file.

music.duckHint: The music gets quieter while the clip has speech and comes back when it stops. Applied on export.

editor.imagesHint: Add a logo, sticker or watermark. Put it in a corner and set its size and opacity.
editor.xfadeHint: How should the next clip come in when one ends? Drag a card onto the point where two clips meet, or click it: it goes on the end of the selected clip (or the cut nearest the playhead). Hover to see it play.
editor.xfadeNoCut: There are no two clips touching yet. Split a clip with S or put two clips side by side to add a transition.
editor.xfadeTileHint: Click: apply to the selected cut · Drag: drop between two clips
editor.xfadeToNext: How should “{{name}}” come in when this clip ends?
editor.xfadeDurationHint: The duration is taken half from each side of the cut, so the total length stays the same.
editor.denoiseHint: Reduces fan, AC and mic hiss. Applied on export.
editor.channelHas: Will be saved from this project: {{parts}}. Then apply it to every new clip in one click.
editor.channelEmpty: First pick an export frame, change a clip's color, add text or a logo; then save them all as one template.
editor.splitHint: In the preview the yellow box picks the camera and the blue box the game: drag a box to move it, use its bottom-right corner to resize. The phone in the corner shows the result.
editor.splitPhone: How it looks on a phone
editor.captionsHint: Speech is transcribed on your computer; the audio isn't sent anywhere. Captions are added for the parts visible on the timeline, then you can edit every line.
editor.captionsFirstRun: The first time, the caption engine and language model (about {{size}}) are downloaded; after that it works offline.
editor.captionsDone: {{count}} captions added. Click a caption to fix it.
editor.captionsNone: No speech found (the video may have no audio).
editor.blurHint: Hide an area you don't want shown, like a name, chat, email or address. Drag the box in the preview and resize it from the handles on its corners and edges. Set its time by dragging the block's edges on the timeline or with the buttons below. To hide something that moves, use 'Make moving' or 'Follow face'.
editor.rampSlowmoHint: The 1 second at the playhead slows down (0.3×); before and after stay as they are.
editor.rampVelocityHint: Fast, then slow-mo at the playhead, then fast again: makes the big moment stand out.
editor.findMoments: Find exciting moments (marks where the audio suddenly gets loud)
editor.dropAnywhere: Audio goes to the music track, video to the media library, images to the logo layer.
editor.laneHint: drag: move · drag an edge: trim · double-click: settings
editor.fxDragHint: Drag onto a clip on the timeline
editor.appliedEmpty: No effects yet. Drag a filter, motion, intro style or transition from the left panels onto this clip.
editor.phoneView: How it looks on a phone
editor.phoneNotVertical: The export frame isn't vertical: there'll be empty space above and below on a phone. Choose Export → Frame → Vertical (9:16).
editor.phoneBlocked: The red-framed text sits under the app's buttons or caption. Move it toward the middle.
editor.detachAudioHint: The clip's audio moves to track A1 as its own block: move and trim it separately from the picture.
editor.reattachAudioHint: The detached audio block is removed and the clip's own sound comes back.
editor.audioDetached: Audio detached to track A1. You can now move and trim it separately from the picture.
editor.audioDetachSpeed: Audio can't be detached from a clip with changed speed. Set the speed to 1× first.
editor.levelMeter: Audio level (red: too loud, may distort)

mode.simpleHint: Only the most used tools: media, text, music, transitions, captions, filters.
mode.proHint: All tools: logo, hiding, presets, color, effects…

editor.startFormat: What are you making it for?
editor.subtitleFileHint: Next to the video with the same name. You can upload it to platforms as separate captions.

toolDesc.media: Add video, audio and images; drag a card onto the timeline.
toolDesc.text: Add titles and text; ready-made text templates.
toolDesc.music: Add music; it ends with the video and ducks under speech.
toolDesc.subtitles: Transcribe speech, pick a style, edit the transcript.
toolDesc.autocut: Remove silences and filler words, shorten to a target, get clip suggestions.
toolDesc.blur: Blur names, chats and similar areas.
toolDesc.clip: Speed, sound, name and transitions of the selected clip.
toolDesc.templates: Ready-made reel layouts, hook text, end screens and a progress bar.

editor.blurTimeHint: The buttons move the start or end of the hidden area to where the playhead is now.
editor.blurKeysHint: Go to a moment in the video and move the box: its position at that moment is saved. The box glides between positions on its own. Turn it off to go back to a fixed box.
editor.blurNoFace: No face found in this range. Put the box over the face and try again, or position it by hand with 'Make moving'.
editor.captionsModelHint: With fast speech and words said twice in a row ("wait wait"), the Fast model sometimes writes only one; More accurate catches them.
editor.textStyleRichHint: This text uses a caption style. Picking a style below removes the caption style and applies yours.

welcome.title: Welcome to DownKit
welcome.body: Download from links, convert, record your screen, trim your clip and share it — completely free, open source, no ads, no account.
welcome.tip: Let me show you around in a minute. You can skip now; the tour can always be reopened from Settings.

editor.title: Clip editor
editor.body: Open a recording or a video from your computer. Split with <k>S</k> and delete what you do not need, add text and filters, and turn it into a vertical short in one click.
editor.tip: Click Open in editor on a recording to jump straight here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Theme, save folder, language, notifications and patch notes live here. Open a support request right from Contact us.
settings.tip: Reopen this tour any time with Settings → Start tutorial.

support.title: One last thing, a small request
support.body: I build DownKit on my own in my free time. It is completely free and open source — no ads, no hidden fees.
support.tip: If it's useful to you and you'd like to give something back for the work, you can donate with Support at the bottom left. It's completely optional, but it would make me very happy. For bugs or ideas, find me on Discord.

help.title: Help on every page
help.body: The Explain this page button at the bottom right walks you through everything on the open page. The first time you open a page, its tour starts by itself.
help.tip: The menu button on the left collapses the menu to icons so the workspace gets bigger. Press it again to bring it back.

record.title: Screen recorder
record.body: Record your screen or a window with sound. With instant replay on, the last 30 seconds are kept in the background; save a great moment with one key.
record.tip: The shortcuts work in games too.

screenshot.title: Screenshots
screenshot.body: In Screenshot, select part of the screen, add arrows, text and numbers, and blur anything private. It can also read and translate the text in the image.
screenshot.tip: Even with DownKit in the background, <k>Alt</k> + <k>Shift</k> + <k>S</k> lets you select an area.

link.title: Paste a link, download
link.body: On the Download page, copy a video link and press Ctrl + V. You'll see the title, length and estimated size; pick a format (MP4, MP3…) and quality and press Download. Downloads and history are further down the same page.
link.tip: Only need part of the video? Turn on Download only part of the video; the rest is never downloaded.

local.title: Files on your computer
local.body: On the Convert page, change a file's format, shrink it (e.g. to fit Discord) or make it vertical/square. The Batch tab does the same job to many files.
local.tip: Your original file is never changed; the result is saved as a new file.

queue.title: Queue and history
queue.body: Every job shows live progress at the bottom of the Download page: percent, speed, time left. Pause, resume or cancel.
queue.tip: Close the window while a job is running and the app moves to the tray next to the clock; nothing is interrupted.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.subtitle: Add a key with + next to an action, remove one with × on the key. Changes are saved right away.

action.trimStart: Cut the clip before the playhead
action.trimEnd: Cut the clip after the playhead

shortcuts.moved: {{combo}} is now "{{to}}"; it was removed from "{{from}}".
shortcuts.mouseHint: With the mouse: Ctrl + wheel zooms, the wheel scrolls, double-clicking a clip plays it, right-click opens a menu. Hold Alt while dragging to bypass the magnet.

intro.title: Clip editor
intro.body: Open a recording or a video from your computer, cut the scenes you want, add text and filters, then export.
intro.tip: A real editor: timeline, split, layers, speed, transitions.

resume.title: Continue where you left off
resume.body: Your last project is saved automatically. Continue opens the video again and brings back your cuts.

drop.title: Or open a file
drop.body: Drop a video or audio file here, or click to pick one. Your original file is never changed.

link.title: Open a link
link.body: Paste a video link and press Open. The video is ready to play in a few seconds; it isn't downloaded.

player.title: Preview
player.body: The video plays here; click to pause, click again to resume. The bar below lets you raise the preview speed (e.g. 2× to skim a long video), set the volume or go full screen.
player.tip: The preview follows your cuts: deleted parts are skipped and gaps go black. The export comes out exactly the same.

tools.title: Right-hand tools: polish a clip
tools.body: With a clip selected, this column belongs to it. Clip: speed, volume, fades at the start and end. Filters: one-click looks (black & white, old film, warm tones…). Color: fine tuning like brightness, contrast and saturation. Effects: touches like vignette and mirroring.
tools.tip: Every change shows instantly in the preview; if you don't like it, just undo.

add.title: Left-hand tools: add to the video
add.body: This column adds things to your video. Text: ready-made title and caption styles. Transitions: smooth joins between two clips. Subtitles: import your own .srt file. Presets: save a look you like and reuse it on another clip with one click.
add.tip: Drag added text into place in the preview; its timing is the purple block on the timeline.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.body: The video starts here as one piece. The white line is the playhead: click or drag on the ruler and the video jumps there. The thin strip at the bottom is a map of the whole video, with a dot marking where you are.
timeline.tip: In a long video, drag the playhead to find your scene; the frames show up as you go.

split.title: Cut: split and delete
split.body: Move the playhead to the start of the scene and press <k>S</k> (or the scissors): the video splits in two. Move to the end of the scene and press <k>S</k> again. The scene is now its own clip; click a part you don't want and press <k>Delete</k>.
split.tip: Deleting leaves a gap, which becomes black screen on export. "Close gaps" pulls the clips together if you don't want that.

clip.title: Clips
clip.body: Click a clip to select it (white frame). Drag an edge to shorten or lengthen it. Drag the middle to move it. Double-click plays the clip. Right-click: duplicate, keep only this, speed.
clip.tip: With the magnet on, edges snap to the playhead and other clips; hold <k>Alt</k> while dragging to bypass it.

layers.title: Layers and track buttons
layers.body: Drag a clip onto the empty row above and it moves to an upper layer; while it plays it shows instead of what's below. The buttons on the left of each row mute or hide that layer: a hidden layer shows nowhere, a muted one stays silent in preview and export alike.
layers.tip: There are up to 3 layers. Use an upper one to cut in another scene.

undo.title: Undo and magnet
undo.body: Cut in the wrong place? <k>Ctrl</k> + <k>Z</k> undoes, <k>Ctrl</k> + <k>Y</k> redoes. The magnet button turns snapping on or off.

zoom.title: Zoom
zoom.body: Zoom with <k>Ctrl</k> + mouse wheel or <k>+</k> / <k>-</k> to work second by second. The wheel scrolls sideways, the frame button shows everything.

panel.title: Clip settings
panel.body: The selected clip's speed (0.25×–4×), volume and fades at its start and end live here. With nothing selected you get the project summary and Close gaps. If the video has chapters they're listed here: click one to jump to it, Split by chapters turns each into its own clip.
panel.tip: A sped-up clip gets shorter; its audio plays at the same speed.

export.title: Download / export
export.body: When you're ready press this button; the settings open in a window in the middle. Pick video, audio only or GIF, then the format and quality. With several parts you can merge them into one file or get separate files. From a link, only the parts you kept are downloaded.
export.tip: With a frame selected, the crop area shows in the preview; even after closing the window you can keep dragging its corners.

shortcuts.title: More
shortcuts.body: Add video, search tools (Ctrl+K), shortcuts and new project are in this menu. You can change any shortcut.
shortcuts.tip: Give a key to another action and it's removed from its old place automatically.

workspace.title: Layout
workspace.body: Arrange the panels your way: drag a tab elsewhere, resize from the line between panels, close with ×. Built-in layouts (Cinema, Studio, Focus…) and your own layouts live in this menu.
workspace.tip: Reopen a closed panel from Layout → Panels.

general.title: General
general.body: Language, start with Windows, advanced settings and tours. Start tutorial reopens the welcome tour.

folders.title: Save folders
folders.body: Where screen recordings and clips exported from the editor go. You can pick a separate folder for each and peek inside with Open folder.
folders.tip: If you'd like recordings sorted into subfolders per game, that's turned on here too.

theme.title: Themes
theme.body: Change how the app looks here. Pick Dark or Light, slide through the themes with the arrows or your mouse wheel and click one to apply it. Under Custom you can choose your own colors and a background image.
theme.tip: Want something dark that won't tire your eyes? Graphite and Pitch Black are for you.

behavior.title: Notifications and window
behavior.body: Sound on save, notify or open the folder when a job finishes, and minimize to the tray on close.

tools.title: Tools and updates
tools.body: FFmpeg version and the DownKit update check. Nothing installs itself; if there is a new version, you are asked first.

about.title: About
about.body: Version, contact (Discord, author page), GitHub and voluntary donations. The legal notice is here too.

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.body: What is new and what got fixed in each version. Click a version to open its page on the website.

hotkeys.title: Hotkeys
hotkeys.body: All recording, instant replay and screenshot hotkeys in one place. Click a box and press new keys to change one.

downloads.title: Download settings
downloads.body: The Download page's default format and quality, file names, how many jobs run at once, the speed limit and platform folders.

subtitles.title: Subtitles
subtitles.body: Subtitle languages for downloads. When you turn on "Download subtitles" on the Download page, these languages are fetched.

privacy.title: History
privacy.body: The history of downloaded files and searched links stays on this computer; turn it off or clear it here.

main.title: Start recording
main.body: Press the red button and the chosen screen or window starts recording with sound. Length, file size and sound levels show here; when you stop, it's saved as an MP4.
main.tip: The shortcut (by default <k>Ctrl</k> + <k>Alt</k> + <k>F9</k>) works while the app is in the background too.

replay.title: Instant replay
replay.body: While it's on, the last 30 seconds (you can change the length) are kept in the background. Did something great just happen? Press Save or the shortcut and it becomes a file, like NVIDIA's Instant Replay.
replay.tip: With Start with the app it's always ready; it also runs alongside a normal recording.

source.title: What to record
source.body: Pick the whole screen or a single window. Frame rate, resolution and quality decide the file size: Balanced is enough for most things.
source.tip: Video is compressed on the graphics card, so games barely slow down.

audio.title: Sound
audio.body: System sound is everything coming out of your speakers (games, videos, calls). Turn on the Microphone to add your voice; each has its own level. The moving bars below them show live whether sound is coming through: if the bar moves, that sound goes into the recording.

hotkeys.title: Shortcuts
hotkeys.body: Keys to start and stop recording, save the instant replay and turn it on or off. Click one and press new keys to change it. If it says Detected next to it, the shortcut works; press it to try right away.
hotkeys.tip: If another program uses the key too, you'll see a warning but the shortcut still works; pressing it may trigger both. If the game runs as administrator, run DownKit as administrator too.

library.title: My recordings
library.body: All your recordings are here. Click one to watch it in the app; from there, Open in editor to cut it, rename it or delete it.
library.tip: Deleted recordings go to the Recycle Bin.

capture.title: Capture
capture.body: Select area freezes the screen so you can drag over the part you want. Whole screen grabs everything at once. Quick translate reads and translates the text in the area you select.
capture.tip: On the selection screen, Enter takes the whole screen, Esc cancels and right-click clears the selection.

hotkeys.title: Shortcuts
hotkeys.body: Do the same from the keyboard — it works even when DownKit is in the tray. Click one and press new keys to change it.

settings.title: What happens after selecting
settings.body: Should Enter open the image in the editor, copy it to the clipboard, or save it straight away? File format (PNG, JPEG, WebP), save folder and delay are here too.

library.title: My screenshots
library.body: Your saved screenshots live here. Click one to open it in the editor; you can also copy it, show it in its folder or delete it.
library.tip: Deleted images go to the Recycle Bin.

tools.title: Drawing tools
tools.body: Arrow, rectangle, pen, highlighter, text, numbered step, blur, pixelate and crop. Pick the color and thickness next to them.
tools.tip: Every tool has a one-letter shortcut (e.g. <k>A</k> arrow, <k>T</k> text); <k>Ctrl</k> + <k>Z</k> undoes.

actions.title: Copy, save, translate
actions.body: Ctrl + C copies to the clipboard, Ctrl + S saves. Read text pulls out the text in the image; Translate places the translation over the original text.

drop.title: Pick a file
drop.body: Drop a file onto the window or click this area to pick one. MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM, AVI, MP3, WAV… most video and audio files work.

file.title: Selected file
file.body: The file's length, resolution, codecs and size. Change picks another file.

start.title: Start
start.body: Press the button; the job joins the queue and its progress appears below.
start.tip: Change the save folder from the line left of the button.

result.title: The result
result.body: Your original file is never changed; the result is saved as a new file. When it's done: Open file or Show in folder.

intro.title: Convert
intro.body: Changes a file's format: MKV to MP4, a video to MP3 and so on.
intro.tip: When the codecs already fit it copies instead of re-encoding: seconds, no quality loss.

options.title: Target format
options.body: Pick the format to convert to. Audio-only formats (MP3, M4A, WAV…) drop the picture.

url.title: Paste the link here
url.body: Copy the link from your browser's address bar, paste it here and press Analyze. Faster: press Ctrl + V on this page; the link is pasted and analyzed right away.
url.tip: Analyzing takes a few seconds. Nothing is downloaded; only the title, length and qualities are read.

platforms.title: Supported sites
platforms.body: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Reddit, Facebook, Twitch, Kick and more. The site of the link you paste is highlighted here.
platforms.tip: Click +3 to see more. Many sites that aren't listed work too.

media.title: Video details
media.body: Title, channel, length and resolution. Open in editor lets you watch without downloading, cut the scenes you want and download only those.
media.tip: Clicking the thumbnail opens the editor too.

section.title: Download only a part
section.body: Turn it on and two handles appear: drag the start and end or type the times (<k>1:24</k>, <k>1:02:03</k>). Only that part of an hour-long video is downloaded.
section.tip: To pick the scene while watching it, use Pick in editor.

actions.title: What do you want to do?
actions.body: Download: save the video or audio. Convert: change the format. Compress: make the file smaller. Resize: make it vertical or square. From a link, these run after the download.
actions.tip: Without an analyzed link, the cards take you to the matching tool for files on your computer.

options.title: Format and quality
options.body: The Basic tab has the format (MP4, MP3…), the quality (each with its estimated size) and the audio quality. The Prepare for platform boxes also make a vertical copy for TikTok, Reels and Shorts; subtitles and small file are here too.
options.tip: Advanced lists every format the site offers, Batch adds many links at once.

start.title: Start
start.body: When you're ready press this button or <k>Enter</k>. The job joins the queue and starts right away; several jobs can run at once.
start.tip: Files go to the save folder shown next to the button. Use Change to pick another folder.

presets.title: Presets
presets.body: One-click setups: best quality MP4, audio-only MP3, small file, Discord-friendly (up to 10 MB), ready for TikTok… Picking one sets the format and quality for you.

queue.title: Job queue
queue.body: Your jobs show live progress here: percent, speed, size and time left. You can pause a download and resume it later, or cancel it. When it's done you get Open file and Show in folder.
queue.tip: For all jobs, open Downloads in the menu.

tools.failed: {{tool}} couldn't be downloaded; check your connection, it retries with the next job.

report.copied: The error report is on your clipboard.
report.where: A new GitHub issue opens with the report filled in; add a sentence about what you were doing and submit it. You can also paste it on Discord (Ctrl+V).
report.privacy: Your user name isn't included; only the version, the error and technical details.

recorder.title: Screen recorder
recorder.subtitle: Record your screen or a single window with sound. With instant replay on, you can save what just happened after the fact.
recorder.sourcesFailed: Screens and windows couldn't be listed.
recorder.sourceMissing: The chosen window isn't open anymore.
recorder.saveFailed: The instant replay couldn't be saved.
recorder.replayOff: Instant replay is off. Turn it on in the Screen recorder page first.
recorder.hotkeyTaken: This shortcut couldn't be registered and the fallback couldn't be set up either; the key won't work right now. Try another combination.
recorder.hotkeyShared: Another program uses this combination too; no problem: DownKit still catches the key in the background and the shortcut works (pressing it may trigger both programs). If it says "Working" above, you're set; try it right away with the "Detected" test.
recorder.screensSelected: {{count}} screens selected — recorded side by side as one video.
recorder.screensPickHint: Click cards to record several screens together.
recorder.encoderHint: The encoder that compresses the video; with a graphics card the CPU barely works.
recorder.replayHint: While on, the last {{length}} are kept in the background. When something great happens, press Save or the shortcut and it becomes a file.
recorder.replayLengthLocked: Turn off replay to change its length.
recorder.hotkeyNeedsModifier: Press it with Ctrl, Alt or Shift (or use an F key).
recorder.lockedWhileActive: Recording is in progress. Stop it first to change these settings.
recorder.screenHint: The whole screen is recorded, full-screen games included. Windows shows DRM-protected videos as black.
recorder.windowHint: Only this window is recorded, even if another window covers it. A minimized window can't be recorded.
recorder.hotkeysHint: They work while the app is in the background, even in a game. Click one and press new keys to change it.
recorder.libraryEmpty: No recordings yet. Start recording, or turn on instant replay and save a moment.
recorder.repairHint: This recording was cut off when the app closed (MKV). Convert it to MP4 so it plays everywhere.
recorder.deleteConfirm: Move this recording to the Recycle Bin?

hud.busy: Still working on the previous action, wait a second.
hud.markedDetail: Shows up on the editor timeline
hud.markerNeedsActive: Start recording or instant replay to mark a moment

recorder.hotkeyReserved: Alt+F4 closes windows in Windows; pick another key.
recorder.hotkeyEditHint: Choose Ctrl / Alt / Shift and pick the key from the list — or just press the keys. A combination another program uses can be assigned too.
recorder.hotkeyAltGrRisk: On some keyboards Ctrl+Alt types a character (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+Q = @ on Turkish); as a shortcut that character couldn't be typed. Adding Shift or using an F key is safer.
recorder.hotkeyFree: Free: no other program uses this combination, it will work.
recorder.hotkeyBusy: Another program uses this combination too. You can still save it: DownKit catches the key in the background and the shortcut works; pressing it may trigger both programs.
recorder.replayOffNotice: Instant replay is off, so there's nothing to save. Press {{key}} or use the switch above to turn it on.
recorder.bitrateHint: Constant bitrate: the value you pick goes straight into the file (size grows with length). 12–20 Mbps is a good start for 1080p60 games.
recorder.speakerDevice: Device to take system sound from
recorder.noiseSuppressionHint: Removes fans, keyboard and hum; lowers the mic while nobody talks.
recorder.byAppHint: Like NVIDIA: recordings go into subfolders such as Recordings\League of Legends.
recorder.trimOverwriteHint: The original goes to the Recycle Bin; the trimmed version takes its name.
recorder.trimOverwritten: Recording trimmed; the original is in the Recycle Bin.
recorder.encoderCpuHint: When no GPU encoder exists; heavy on the CPU
recorder.advancedHint: If recording slows your game down, pick "Performance". If the chosen card can’t be opened, recording won’t start and you’ll be told; it never silently falls back to the CPU.
recorder.showAdvanced: Show advanced settings (graphics card, encoder, bitrate…)
recorder.copyFileHint: Copy the file: paste it into Discord or WhatsApp with Ctrl+V
recorder.copyFileDone: Copied. Paste it into Discord or WhatsApp with Ctrl+V.
recorder.pickHint: Click recordings to add them to a montage or delete them.
recorder.montageHint: The selected recordings open in one project in date order, with crossfades between them.
recorder.bulkDeleteConfirm: Move {{count}} recordings to the Recycle Bin?
recorder.replayOnGameHint: When a full-screen game comes to the front, instant replay turns on by itself and turns off when the game closes. Browsers and video players don't count.
recorder.micSeparate: Also record the mic to its own audio track
recorder.micSeparateHint: The file gets 2 audio tracks: track 1 has everything (what every player plays), track 2 is the mic only. Turn on if you want to edit your voice separately later.

twilight.name: Twilight
twilight.hint: Night with violet and pink accents

fog.name: Morning Fog
fog.hint: Light grey, easy on the eyes

calm.name: Calm
calm.hint: Default · soft, easy on the eyes

snip.title: Screenshot
snip.subtitle: Select part of the screen, add arrows, text and numbers, blur what should stay private, then copy or save. It can also read and translate the text in the image.
snip.hint: Drag to select an area · Enter: whole screen · Esc: cancel
snip.hintTranslate: Drag over the text you want to translate · Esc: cancel
snip.loadFailed: Couldn't load the image. It may have been moved or deleted.
snip.discardConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Close anyway?
snip.noText: No readable text was found in the image.
snip.ocrFailed: Couldn't read the text in the image.
snip.libraryEmpty: No saved screenshots yet. Pick an area above or press the shortcut.

capture.regionHint: Freezes the screen so you can drag over the part you want.
capture.fullHint: Captures the entire screen the mouse is on, in one go.
capture.translateHint: Reads the text in the area you select and translates English ↔ Turkish.
capture.fileHint: Open a PNG, JPEG or WebP from your computer in the editor.

snip.hotkeysHint: They work even when DownKit is in the background or in the tray. Click one and press new keys to change it.
snip.enterAction: When you press Enter (or the shortcut)

enter.editHint: To add arrows, text or blur

snip.copyOnSave: Also copy to clipboard when saving
snip.copyOnSaveHint: The image you save is ready to paste.
snip.delayHint: Applies to the buttons on this page: gives you time to open a menu or tooltip that disappears when you click.
snip.pngLossless: PNG is lossless: no quality setting needed.
snip.qualityHint: Lower quality means smaller files; 85–95% is fine for most things.
snip.translationHint: Text is read on your computer by Windows' own engine. To translate, only the text (never the image) is sent to the free MyMemory service; the daily limit is about 5,000 characters.
snip.translateOpensEditorHint: When off, quick translate works without bringing DownKit forward: the text is read, translated and copied to the clipboard. When on, the result opens in the editor.
snip.minimizeAppHint: When off, DownKit stays put and appears in the shot. When on, it minimizes to the taskbar and comes back afterwards.

setup.title: Let us set up DownKit
setup.useTitle: What do you want to record?
setup.useHint: I will set things up for you; you can change everything later on the Screen Recording page.
setup.useGamesHint: Instant replay always on: when something great happens, save the last 30 seconds with one key.
setup.useScreenHint: Record your screen for a lesson, a presentation or to show a bug. Files are smaller.
setup.useBothHint: Instant replay plus normal recording whenever you want.
setup.audioHint: Which sounds should go into recordings?
setup.systemAudioHint: Game, video, music: whatever comes out of your speakers.
setup.microphoneHint: Your own voice. Apps like Discord keep using your microphone as usual.
setup.folderHint: Pick once and it stays. You can also reach recordings from the Screen Recording page.
setup.advancedHint: Graphics card, encoder, bitrate and resolution settings. Leave it off if unsure.

share.webhookHint: Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → Copy URL. Clips go to that channel in one click.
share.webhookInvalid: That isn't a Discord webhook link.
share.webhookTestMessage: DownKit is connected to this channel ✅
share.webhookOk: A test message was sent to the channel.

project.recentEmpty: Projects you save show up here. In the editor, Save (Ctrl+S) stores it as a .downkit file.
project.missingHint: The project uses these files but they're not where they were (maybe moved or deleted). Show where they are now, or skip; a skipped file's clips are removed from the project.
project.nothingLeft: No files left in the project that can be opened.

error.invalid: This file is damaged or isn't a DownKit project.
error.newer: This project was saved with a newer version of DownKit. Update the app and try again.
error.empty: The project has no video or audio file that can be opened.

palette.title: Search tools
palette.placeholder: What do you want to do? (e.g. captions, detach audio, transition)

captionStudio.title: Caption style
captionStudio.hintNone: Make captions or select a text first; the style you pick is also used for new captions.
captionStudio.hintAll: Changes apply to all {{count}} auto captions.
captionStudio.hintSelected: Changes apply to the selected text.
captionStudio.wordsHint: When making captions, lines are split with this many words (1: word by word).
captionStudio.emojiHint: Based on keywords: money 💰, fire 🔥, funny 😂… Change a line's emoji from the transcript.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.hint: Click a word to jump there. Star: keyword (always highlighted). Pencil: fix the line.
transcript.filler: Filler word: you can remove it from the Shorten panel
transcript.selectHint: Edit by text: drag across words or Shift+click to select; cut the selection from the video or move it before another sentence. Scissors: cut the whole sentence.
transcript.moveHint: Click “Move here” above a sentence to move it there.
transcript.cutLine: Cut this sentence from the video
transcript.cut: {{seconds}} s cut. Press Ctrl+Z to undo.

autoCut.title: Remove silences
autoCut.hint: Finds the parts where nobody talks. After cutting, everything after shifts left; captions, logo and detached audio move along.
autoCut.noAudio: The videos in this project have no audio.
autoCut.thresholdHint: Raise it for noisy recordings (e.g. −30 dB); lower it in a quiet room.
autoCut.noSpeech: No speech found in this video: almost all of it looks silent. Nothing is suggested for removal (try lowering the threshold).
autoCut.voiceTrack: Checked the separate microphone track: quiet moments were found even while game audio plays.
autoCut.removed: {{seconds}} s shorter. Press Ctrl+Z to undo.
autoCut.bandCut: {{seconds}} s of silence will be cut. Click: keep
autoCut.bandKept: {{seconds}} s of silence will stay. Click: cut

fillers.title: Filler words and repeats
fillers.hint: “um, uh, hmm” and stutters are selected for you; pick words like “like, basically” yourself.

shorten.title: Shorten to a target
shorten.already: The video is already under {{seconds}} seconds.
shorten.needCaptions: Create captions to also get filler words and unnecessary sentences suggested.
shorten.notReached: {{after}} s: pick more sentences or split the video to get under {{seconds}} seconds.

suggest.title: Get clips from a long video
suggest.hint: Suggests shareable parts based on your markers, exciting moments in the audio, chapters and speech.
suggest.better: Create captions or find exciting moments with ⚡ for better suggestions.
suggest.none: No suggestions: the video is too short for this length.
suggest.saved: {{count}} draft projects saved. Open them with Open project.

layouts.title: Layout
layouts.duoHint: In the preview, the yellow and orange boxes pick the two cameras, the blue box picks the game.
layouts.podcastPlaced: Both people were placed by their faces.
layouts.podcastNoFaces: Couldn't find two faces side by side; you can place the boxes by hand.
layouts.podcastHint: In the preview, the yellow box picks the person on top, the blue box the one below.

face.title: Follow the face
face.hint: The frame follows the speaker's face automatically. Runs on your computer; video never leaves it.
face.on: Face tracking is on: the frame follows the face.
face.done: Face tracking is on · a face was found in {{percent}}% of frames.
face.none: No face found in the video; you can set the frame by hand.

workspace.menuHint: Panel layout: built-in layouts, your layouts, panels
workspace.name: Layout name
workspace.transcriptEmpty: Transcribe the speech first to get a transcript.

phone.swap: Move the camera to the top / bottom
phone.camera: Camera: drag, resize from the corner

templates.hint: Click to apply to your project; text, colors and layout stay editable. Picking a template of the same type again replaces its text.

sectionHint.layout: Sets up the frame, background and title text together.
sectionHint.hook: Big text that keeps viewers in the first 2–3 seconds.
sectionHint.end: A follow / part 2 call in the last seconds.

cover.title: Cover image
cover.hint: A full-resolution cover from the frame at the playhead, with your video's layout (vertical crop, background, camera layout). The title is written on top; saved to Pictures\DownKit.
cover.gap: The playhead is in a gap: move it onto a clip for the cover.

brand.title: Brand kit
brand.hint: Your channel's font, colors, logo, caption style, intro and outro text. Save it once, apply it to every video in one click.
brand.new: New brand kit (fill from this project)
brand.name: Kit name
brand.apply: Apply the {{name}} kit to this project

multiFormat.title: Also save in other formats
multiFormat.hint: Export the same video as vertical, square and landscape in one go. Each format becomes its own file. You can place texts separately in each format: pick the format below and drag the texts on the video.
multiFormat.editing_one: {{count}} format. Pick a format to place the texts:
multiFormat.editing_other: {{count}} formats. Pick a format to place the texts:
multiFormat.previewOne: Preview in {{name}} and place the texts
multiFormat.same: Use the same text positions in every format

transform.title: Transform
transform.addKey: {{name}}: add a keyframe at the playhead
transform.removeKey: {{name}}: delete the keyframe at the playhead
transform.outside: Move the playhead over the clip to add keyframes
transform.deleteKeys: Delete the keyframes at the playhead
transform.keysHint: Changing a value adds a keyframe at the playhead

speedCurve.title: Speed curve
speedCurve.hint: Changes the speed along the clip. Pick a preset or drag the points up and down; double-click to add a point, double-click a point to remove it. Apply splits the clip into short pieces; Ctrl+Z undoes it.
speedCurve.motionBlurHint: Blends consecutive frames on sped-up footage so motion looks smoother. Applied in the exported video.

freeze.hint: The frame at the playhead holds for 2 seconds; everything after it moves 2 seconds later. Drag the clip edge to change the length.
freeze.isFrozen: Freeze frame: the picture holds on this frame, no audio. Drag its edge to change the length.

reverse.label: Play in reverse
reverse.hint: The clip plays from end to start (picture and audio). The preview is silent; the exported video has the reversed audio. Works on clips up to {{seconds}} seconds; split longer clips first.

lookFx.title: Look effects
lookFx.hint: Click a card to drop the effect on the effect strip at the playhead (it is added to the selected block); drag it onto a clip to apply it to the whole clip. Hover a card to see it live. Set the strength with the sliders below.
lookFx.noFavorites: No favorite effects yet. Press the star on a card.

hints.glitch: The picture jitters and shifts color a few times a second; digital glitch.
hints.rgbSplit: Red and blue channels shift sideways; a colored double edge.
hints.strobe: The picture flashes rhythmically; for beats and transitions.
hints.grain: Fine, flickering grain like film; a warm analog texture.
hints.lightLeak: A warm, slowly drifting light leaking in from the edge.
hints.vhs: Old video tape: color bleed, scanlines and grain.
hints.sharpen: Makes edges crisper; sharpens soft footage.

grade.title: Color grading
grade.hint: Start with exposure and tint; drag the dot in the shadow, midtone and highlight wheels toward a color to shift that range (double-click resets). Levels open up darks, mids and brights separately; fine-tune with the curve. Use the eyedropper on something that should be gray. Scopes show the frame at the playhead.
grade.autoDone: White balance, exposure and levels adjusted.
grade.pickHint: Click something in the video that should be gray or white: the color cast is removed.
grade.noFrame: Couldn't read the preview frame (try again once the video has loaded).
grade.lutBad: This LUT couldn't be read for the preview; it is still applied when exporting.
grade.clipped: {{percent}}% of the picture is clipping to white. Lower the exposure or the brights a little.

audioFx.title: Audio repair
audioFx.hint: Press Speech or Music for matching settings, then fine-tune with the sliders. Noise reduces fans and hum, echo the room sound, wind the low rumble; enhance makes speech clearer. Applied in the exported video; use Before/After to hear 6 seconds from the playhead.
audioFx.loudnessHint: The mix is brought to −14 LUFS and peaks are limited: not too quiet, not distorted on phones.

beats.hint: Beats in the music are found and shown as thin lines on the timeline; clips snap to them while dragging. 'Cut to the beat' splits the main video track every 1, 2 or 4 beats.

envelope.title: Volume envelope
envelope.hint: The line is the music's level over time. Drag a point up or down, double-click to add a point, double-click a point to remove it. The presets dip the middle for speech or swell in and out.

voice.saved: Voiceover added where the recording started.
voice.noMic: Couldn't open the microphone. Check the microphone permission in Windows settings.

shareCheck.title: Check before sharing
shareCheck.textInZone: {{count}} text item(s) sit under the phone's buttons or caption area; move them toward the middle in the Phone panel.
shareCheck.imageInZone: {{count}} logo/sticker(s) sit under the phone's buttons or caption area.
shareCheck.gap: There are {{seconds}} s of black gaps between clips (Close gaps removes them).
shareCheck.silent: There's no audible sound (clips are silent, no music).
shareCheck.loudness: Turn on 'Social media loudness' so it sounds even on phones.
shareCheck.landscape: The video is landscape. Pick 9:16 for short-video apps.
shareCheck.long: The video is {{seconds}} s; short videos under 90 seconds get watched more.

zoom.addPanHint: From the playhead, the view slowly moves from one area to another while zoomed in. The purple box is the start, the blue box the end: drag both on the video.
zoom.title: Zoom
zoom.band: Zoom {{n}}×: drag, or drag an edge to resize

effectLane.title: Effects
effectLane.cardsHint: Clicking a card drops the effect on the effect lane above the timeline at the playhead; move it or drag its edge to resize. Drag a card onto a clip to apply it to the whole clip. With a block selected, clicking a card changes that block.

transitions.hint: Clicking a between-clips transition puts it on the cut nearest the playhead; clicking an in / out transition puts it on the nearest clip edge. You can drag a card onto any cut or clip edge on the timeline, and drag a transition marker to another cut to move it.
transitions.noClip: There is no clip on the timeline.

home.cardsHint: Without a link, these cards open the tools for files on your computer. You can also drag a file onto the window.

analyze.moreHint: …and hundreds of other sites yt-dlp supports.

validation.unsupported: This link doesn't look like a supported platform yet.
validation.invalid: This doesn't look like a valid link.

actions.downloadDesc: Download from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and more.
actions.convertDesc: Save as MP4, WebM, MP3, M4A and more.
actions.compressDesc: Shrink the file while keeping quality.

presets.title: Format & quality presets
presets.gifDesc: Animated image, no sound; for short clips
presets.quickSubtitle: Pick one and start right away

downloads.title: Downloads & history
downloads.subtitle: Running jobs progress live in the queue; finished files and the links you searched are in the History tab.
downloads.sessionNote: Finished files are also saved in the History tab.

batch.subtitle: Paste several links and add them all to the queue at once.
batch.usesOptions: The format and quality selected in the Basic tab are used.
batch.addedWithSkipped: {{count}} links added · {{skipped}} were already in the queue.

convert.title: Convert
convert.subtitle: Change the format of a video or audio file on your computer.

compress.title: Compress
compress.subtitle: Shrink a local video while keeping as much quality as possible. The original is never changed.
compress.presetHighDesc: Up to 1080p, looks almost the same
compress.presetSmallDesc: 720p and at most 30 fps, small file
compress.tooSmall: This target is very small; because of the minimum quality limit the result may be slightly larger.
compress.summaryPreset: Original: {{size}} · the result is saved as a new MP4
compress.advancedHint: Lowering the resolution or frame rate makes the file even smaller and speeds up compression. Videos are never upscaled.

resize.title: Resize
resize.subtitle: Target a resolution, an aspect ratio or a platform preset.
resize.fitCropDesc: Fills the frame, may crop the edges
resize.fitPadDesc: Keeps the whole frame, adds black bars

playlist.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}} videos ({{total}} in the list).
playlist.partOfList: This video is part of a playlist.
playlist.noAdvanced: Every video in a playlist is different, so advanced format picking isn't available. The quality from the Basic tab is applied to each video.

batchFiles.title: Batch
batchFiles.subtitle: Do the same job to many files: change the format, shrink or resize.
batchFiles.dropHint: Drag files here or press Add files.
batchFiles.unreadable: A file couldn't be read and was skipped.

motion.title: Motion title
motion.hint: Ready-made animated titles: pick a template, type the text and colour, add it over the video. Position, size and duration work like an image layer.
motion.backgroundHint: When off, only the text and shapes go over the video.
motion.renderFailed: The title could not be rendered. Is FFmpeg installed?
motion.credit: Templates are drawn with the EffectCraft engine (MIT / Apache-2.0).
